incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2: increased 99th pct latency for /v1/generate in us-west-2 – paging oncall Maya
Maya (oncall): seeing it, digging in. grabbing metrics and traces now.
Maya (oncall): Raj, can you confirm if any autoscaler events around 14:02 UTC?
Raj (sre): checking HPA and node events... `kubectl get hpa -n inference` shows no scale up in last 30m. cluster autoscaler logs? pulling.
Linh (eng-runtime): I see elevated KV cache miss rate on the runtime side, looks like cold cache churn after a recent deploy. stack shows more KV lookups -> latency.
Maya (oncall): deploy-bot, which deploys went out before 14:00?
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-06-12T13:58:42Z by lin.h — rollout to canary (10%) completed, no errors reported.
Raj (sre): confirming cluster nodes healthy, no CPU spikes. latency increase correlates with a spike in backend model inference time 14:01-14:06.
Tom (cs): We're getting customer pings about slow responses for chats. Priority customers: Acme and BrightApp. Tom: Acme reports >10s responses.
Maya (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) revert canary rollout 2) route traffic to dedicated pool in us-west-2 3) enable prefix caching for hot prompts. I'll start revert if Linh approves.
Linh (eng-runtime): I can revert canary. but pref route fallback first — switching route will avoid churn. prepping route change.
Maya (oncall): doing route change now: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/re-route -d '{"route":"dedicated-usw2","match":"/v1/generate"}'`
Maya (oncall): route switch initiated. :hourglass_flowing_sand: monitor for latency drop.
Raj (sre): collecting traces: `otel-query "service=runtime AND span.duration>500ms" --from=14:00 --to=14:10` saving to /tmp/incident-1768500000-traces.json
Priya (secops): FYI SecOps watching — any config changes must be logged. I noticed audit logs for control-plane at 13:58 show a gap between 13:57-14:05 in the audit export stream. tagging as potential compliance issue.
Maya (oncall): Latency 99th dropped from 9.3s -> 1.1s within 90s after route switch. Looks good. Customer alerts fading.
Tom (cs): letting Acme know we mitigated and will follow up with RCA. They want ETA on postmortem.
Maya (oncall): I'll schedule postmortem. suggested owners: Linh (runtime), Raj (sre), Priya (secops) for audit log gap + evidence collection, Tom for customer comms.
Linh (eng-runtime): I'll open a revert PR and also roll a targeted fix for KV cache warming.
Raj (sre): Action item: preserve stateful nodes, collect docker/container logs and tracer snapshots. Commands I ran:
```
sudo journalctl -u inference-runtime --since "2026-06-12T13:45:00Z" > /tmp/runtime-journal.txt
docker inspect --format '{{.Id}} {{.State.Status}}' $(docker ps -q) > /tmp/containers.txt
aws ec2 create-snapshot --volume-id vol-0abcd1234 --description "incident-1768500000-preserve"
```
I'll upload to the incident bucket.
Priya (secops): For compliance: we need to collect evidence and preserve audit logs for the timeframe 13:30-14:30 UTC. Note that the audit export had a gap — immediately archive whatever partial logs we have and create a ticket for cloud provider support. Also lock down who can access the incident bucket.
Priya (secops): Command to export remaining audit logs: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_cluster" AND timestamp>="2026-06-12T13:30:00Z" AND timestamp<="2026-06-12T14:30:00Z"' --format json > /tmp/audit-window.json`
Priya (secops): Also run an access control sweep: `./scripts/check-iam.sh --roles audit-exporter,control-plane-admin` and post results.
Maya (oncall): Handoff note for next oncall (in 50 minutes): incident mitigated via routing to dedicated-usw2 pool. Root cause suspected: canary rollout changed kernel path for KV cache leading to elevated cold misses. Audit export gap needs SecOps follow-up.
Raj (sre): I'm creating INC-176850 (internal) and linking to JIRA: REDWOOD-8472. Will add logs and tracer dump.
Linh (eng-runtime): I'll prepare a small reproducer and a patch for cache warming. ETA EOD.
Tom (cs): I'll draft customer-facing timeline and updates; will include mitigation time and next PM meeting invite.
Priya (secops): Post-incident tasks (assign): 1) evidence collection owner: Priya — collect archive + open cloud ticket. 2) access control review: Priya & Raj — report due +7 days. 3) runtime fix owner: Linh — PR + tests. 4) postmortem writeup: Maya & Linh — due +3 days.
Maya (oncall): Scheduling postmortem: proposing 2026-06-13 16:00 UTC (30m). Who can attend?
Raj (sre): I can join.
Linh (eng-runtime): yes.
Priya (secops): I'll join.
Tom (cs): I'll attend for customer notes.
Maya (oncall): Great. I've created a calendar invite and linked REDWOOD-8472.
Maya (oncall): Quick security note for oncall handoff: ensure we don't delete preserved artifacts. Next oncall, please avoid any cluster-side restarts involving the preserved volumes.
Priya (secops): Also flagging we should add an automated monitor for audit export gaps. Filing SEC-121 to add alerting and runbook.
Raj (sre): final checklist before I sign off: logs uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/1768500000/, snapshots created, tracer dump present, and route rollback PR created. All checked.
Maya (oncall): Thanks team. handing off to night oncall in 40m — @here summary pinned to channel, and assigned action items in REDWOOD-8472.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=SEV-2, incident_id=INC-176850, postmortem_meeting=2026-06-13T16:00:00Z

Priya (secops): I'll post initial evidence packet by EOD and update this thread when cloud support ticket is opened.
Linh (eng-runtime): will follow up with reproducible logs and PR link.
Tom (cs): Customer updated, they acknowledged. thanks.
